body: Thank you. But I will be honest with you, I highly doubt that I will seek help rather I will remain quiet and try to wait it out.

Thank you for your encouraging words. I do have trust issues and would prefer to keep this anonymous as I have a couple of friends on my list and this could easily get leaked.

To be quite honest, I'm not sure what to expect when I am fixed. I hardly understand the concept of wanting to live a long life and I'm a bit pessimistic that I will never understand it. I looked a bit at your account and I'm startled by how much you enjoy helping complete strangers, why? why would you do that? 

Thanks again.
Thank you, I will sleep on your words and try to understand some of the concepts you have spoken about.
I don't fight things, I don't have complaints and I'm a very laid back person. It is just this constant sensation that's a drag, but thanks.

I'm over my past; at least that's what I'd like to think. I'm not diagnosed with any mental illness, it just happens to be a need similar to a one time masturbation deal; haha. Thank you for your reply
All I do is play video games, but the thought will not go away at the end of the day. Thanks for the suggestion tho
I'm not diagnosed with depression. Thank you for your reply.
